steps.subtitle_en: Just a few simple details so we can get started.
steps.subtitle_zh: 填写简单资料，我们就能开始了。

steps.subtitle_en: A clear IC photo helps us keep everything safe.
steps.subtitle_zh: 上传清晰的身份证照片，让一切更安心。

steps.subtitle_en: Review and agree — you're ready to go.
steps.subtitle_zh: 确认并同意，马上就能加入。

ic_number.help_en: 12 digits; dashes are added for you
ic_number.help_zh: 12 位数字，横线会自动加上

area.placeholder_zh: 选择你主要活动的地区

errors.text_en: The date in the IC is not valid.
You must be 18 or older to register.
Photo is too large. Please compress and try again.
errors.text_zh: 照片太大，请压缩后再上传。

errors.text_en: Photo format not supported. Please use JPG or PNG.
errors.text_zh: 照片格式不支援，请使用 JPG 或 PNG。

errors.text_en: Photo is blurry. Please retake a clearer one.
Please agree to the consent to continue.

why_ic.body_en: To confirm your identity, protect your commission payments and prevent impersonation. Only the company owner can view it. It is stored securely, never sold, and only shared where the law requires.
why_ic.body_zh: 用来确认身份、保障你的佣金发放、防止冒名。只有公司负责人看得到。资料安全保存，绝不出售，除法律要求外不会提供给他人。

photo_tips.en: Place your IC on a plain surface with good lighting.
photo_tips.zh: 把身份证放在平坦背景，光线充足。

photo_tips.en: Make sure all text and the photo are sharp and clear.
photo_tips.zh: 确保所有文字和照片都清晰可读。

photo_tips.en: Avoid glare, shadows, or covering any part of the IC.
photo_tips.zh: 避免反光、阴影，不要遮挡任何部分。

submitted.body_en: We've received your details. We'll review them and get back to you soon.
submitted.body_zh: 我们已收到你的资料，会尽快审核并回复你。

approved.body_en: Your identity is confirmed. Finish the required courses and the certification exam to start taking orders.
approved.body_zh: 你的身份已确认。完成必修课和认证考试后，就能开始接单。

rejected.body_en: We couldn't confirm your details this time. Please check the reason below, update and submit again.
rejected.body_zh: 这次未能确认你的资料。请查看下方原因，修改后重新提交。

consent_draft.body_en: EWCRESCENDO SDN. BHD. (EW VERDORA) collects your legal name, preferred name, IC number, IC front photo, WhatsApp number and area to confirm your identity, pay your commissions and meet legal requirements. Only the company owner can view your IC details. Your data is stored securely with our cloud service providers, is never sold, and is shared with others only where the law requires. You may request to view, correct or delete your data, or withdraw this consent, by emailing ewverdora@gmail.com; after our cooperation ends we will delete it unless the law requires us to keep it. This consent form is a draft and requires company confirmation.
consent_draft.body_zh: EWCRESCENDO SDN. BHD.（EW VERDORA）会收集你的法定姓名、称呼、身份证号码、身份证正面照片、WhatsApp 电话和地区，用于确认身份、发放佣金及符合法律要求。只有公司负责人可以查看你的身份证资料。资料安全保存在我们的云端服务供应商系统中，绝不出售，除法律要求外不会提供给他人。你可以发电邮至 ewverdora@gmail.com，申请查阅、更正或删除资料，或撤回本同意；合作结束后，除非法律要求保留，我们会删除你的资料。本同意书为草稿，需经公司确认。
